performance_case.causal_mechanism: Versioning both hypothesis-design lanes onto the accepted interpretation-runner V2 root prevents a deterministic post-positive stall while preserving every frozen scientific contract and fail-closed branch.
performance_case.claim_boundary: This implementation may prove only offline Local tooling identity, versioned self-attestation and synthetic fail-closed behavior. It cannot access outcomes or establish prediction, fees, slippage, capacity, matched-capital PnL, drawdown improvement, candidate readiness, OOS value, deployment or Trading authority.
performance_case.drawdown_hypothesis: Immediate drawdown effect is zero. Market drawdown improvement remains MISSING_PROOF until a later preregistered matched-capital strategy experiment passes independent Validation and sealed OOS gates.
performance_case.opportunity_cost: Leaving both downstream lanes on the historical V1 root would discard or delay the learning value of a future positive V2 interpretation; changing scientific bytes after outcome access would create selection bias, so the closure must finish before evidence arrives.
performance_case.performance_hypothesis: The eight-file closure cannot improve fee-adjusted PnL directly, but it removes a known post-interpretation bottleneck and shortens time to a credible strategy accept-or-reject decision without adding variants or relaxing gates.
